definitions.explanation: Having no value, worth, or usefulness. Used of objects, ideas, efforts, or a person's self-image when they are judged to be of no worth at all.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無価値|むかち}だ。
⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{無価値|むかち}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}わない→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I don't think the effort was worthless.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{無価値|むかち}な⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{感|かん}じて→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧しまうこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When failures pile up, you can end up feeling like a worthless person.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) + ⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧ (value). A na-adjective (and noun) meaning having no value at all. Its opposite is ⟦{有意義|ゆういぎ}→有意義：13020_yuuigi⟧ (meaningful) or simply ⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have value).

USAGE:
- As a na-adjective: {無価値|むかち}な + noun ({無価値|むかち}な⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧)
- As a predicate: {無価値|むかち}だ / {無価値|むかち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無価値|むかち}なもの: a worthless thing
- {無価値|むかち}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel that something is worthless

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無意味|むいみ}→無意味：15527_muimi⟧: meaningless; pointless — stresses lack of meaning or purpose, not lack of worth
- ⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have no value — a phrase with the same sense, more everyday in tone
